subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: After the classifier gap is fixed, should this PR wait for redacted live Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source/test evidence only?
rationale: The change affects visible Telegram/session delivery and the contributor has not supplied an after-fix live artifact; automation cannot verify the contributor's real channel setup or safely waive that proof gate.

options.title: Require Fix Plus Live Proof
options.body: Fix the missing-output classifier gap and require a redacted Telegram recording, logs, or transcript showing background-task completion reaches the owning topic with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only After Fix
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the remaining real-channel delivery risk after the code finding is fixed and source tests are green.

recommendation.title: Require Fix Plus Live Proof
recommendation.body: Fix the missing-output classifier gap and require a redacted Telegram recording, logs, or transcript showing background-task completion reaches the owning topic with heartbeat isolation enabled.
